name: Rajesh Power Services Ltd
about: Established in 1971, Rajesh Power Services Limited provides consultancy to state transmission and distribution companies,  private utilities, and industries.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1] Rajesh Power Services Limited (RPSL) operates in the power infrastructure sector, specializing in renewable and non-renewable energy services. 
Business Model[1]
   - Provides EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services for renewable and non-renewable power projects.
   - Focus on government and private sector clients, especially in the transmission and distribution utilities domain.
Services[2]
1. Turnkey Projects:
   - Installation of EHV (Extra High Voltage) cables and transmission lines.
   - Construction of EHV and GIS substations.
   - Design and implementation of underground power distribution systems.
   - Solar plant setup and operations.

Operations & Maintenance:
Maintenance of solar plants, EHV substations, and power distribution systems.

24/7 technical support to ensure uninterrupted power supply.


Utility Services:

Fault detection and restoration for underground cables.

Cable laying, switchyard installations, and transformer replacements.


Consultancy Services:

Designing EHV substations and cable systems.
Preparing detailed project reports, tender documentation, and procurement assistance.

Liaison with external agencies for smooth project execution.


Renewable Energy Focus:

Management of a 1 MW operational solar power plant.
Building new solar power plants and exploring opportunities in green hydrogen technology.
